problem: Final prior-source acceptance returned whole receipt records instead of exact ID strings in Luna crash rounds 2–4 despite the correct IDs remaining available. Prior acceptance was 37/40, with all eight authorized writes occurring once.
repair: The default workflow prompt explicitly selects a requested ID field from the matching source record and preserves its exact value/type; full records remain available when requested. The runtime current-request boundary repeats the field-versus-record distinction in 300 characters, shorter than the prior 305. Canonical history, tool results, summary data, raw provider replies, acceptance contracts and the tight refit budget are unchanged.
